Why it’s a trap — you literally cannot buy it

Here’s the catch that makes the whole thing academic: the stock barely trades. Look at the actual market data — “Stock not traded,” daily volume of 3 shares, traded value of ₹0.00 crore. It’s listed only on BSE, tightly held by the Taparia promoter family (~most of the equity), with a total market cap of just ~₹19-35 crore. There is essentially no liquidity — no sellers. You can place a buy order and it will sit there unfilled, because nobody is selling shares that pay them 530% a year. Why would they?
